tools.name: audit_site
tools.description: Run a free lite Pronova Score audit for a website URL: on-site technical SEO checks, Core Web Vitals, and Google Search Console indexing status (when available). Free and instant. The result includes a full-report link, and when the score leaves room to improve it also carries an offer worth sharing

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "audit_site" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
